tools.name: get_site_info
tools.description: Retorna nome, descrição, idioma e recursos para agentes deste site.

tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Busca páginas e posts publicados no site. Retorna título, URL, data e resumo.

tools.name: get_content
tools.description: Retorna o conteúdo completo de uma página ou post em Markdown, por ID ou URL.

tools.name: list_recent
tools.description: Lista os itens publicados mais recentes.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_content, get_content · Public sink: get_content.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_content, get_content · Public sink: get_content

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
